steam.title: Import Steam Games
steam.description: Connect Steam, scan your owned, shared, and wishlisted games, and review everything before it reaches Library.

connect.title: Connect your Steam account
connect.description: Steam import starts from your connected Steam account. We will use it to read your library, wishlist, shared games, and playtime before anything gets imported.

prefs.title: Choose what to include
prefs.description: These preferences shape how the Steam scanner builds candidates before the review step.

nonPlayed.title: Include unplayed games
nonPlayed.description: Bring in games from your Steam library even if they still show zero playtime.

wishlist.title: Include wishlisted games
wishlist.description: Steam wishlist entries will land in LastSave as wishlist items and skip local path requirements.

family.title: Import games from family shared library
family.description: Only family-shared games you actually played will be included, so LastSave does not pull in an entire shared library you never touched.

autoSync.title: Auto-sync games
autoSync.description: Imported owned and family-shared games will keep playtime aligned with Steam.

disconnect.title: Disconnect Steam?
disconnect.message: Disconnecting will remove the Steam connection from this wizard and clear the linked Steam session for LastSave.

capabilities.title: What to bring in from Epic
capabilities.description: Everything your Epic account knows about — what you own, how long you've played it, and what you have wishlisted. Installed games arrive with their launch path.

unplayed.title: Include unplayed games
unplayed.description: Bring in games from your Epic library even if they still show zero playtime.

wishlist.title: Include wishlisted games
wishlist.description: Bring in what you have wishlisted on the Epic store, dated to when you added it.

autoSync.title: Auto-sync games
autoSync.description: Imported games will keep playtime aligned with Epic.

connect.title: Connect your Epic account
connect.description: Epic can tell LastSave which games you own, how long you've played them, and what you've wishlisted. Games already installed here are found by This PC either way.
connect.expired: Your Epic session expired. Reconnect to keep importing and syncing.
connect.disclaimer: LastSave is not affiliated with Epic Games. Connecting signs you in with Epic and keeps the resulting token encrypted on this PC.

disconnect.title: Disconnect Epic?
disconnect.message: Your imported Epic games stay in your library with their hours and history. Only syncing with Epic stops. You can reconnect the same account at any time.

capabilities.title: What to bring in from Xbox
capabilities.description: Every game your Xbox account has played — on PC, Game Pass and console — with the hours Xbox kept. Installed games arrive with their launch path.

console.title: Include console games
console.description: Games you played on an Xbox console. LastSave keeps their history and hours; it can't start them.

autoSync.title: Auto-sync games
autoSync.description: Imported games will keep playtime aligned with Xbox.

capabilities.historyNote: Xbox shares the games you've played, so a game bought and never launched won't appear, and Game Pass games look the same as the ones you bought.

connect.title: Connect your Xbox account
connect.description: Xbox can tell LastSave every game you've played — on PC, Game Pass and console — and how long. Games already installed here are found by This PC either way.
connect.expired: Your Xbox session expired. Reconnect to keep importing and syncing.
connect.disclaimer: LastSave is not affiliated with Microsoft or Xbox. You sign in on Microsoft's own page; LastSave keeps the resulting token encrypted on this PC.

disconnect.title: Disconnect Xbox?
disconnect.message: Your imported Xbox games stay in your library with their hours and history. Only syncing with Xbox stops. You can reconnect the same account at any time.

unified.title: Import Games
unified.description: Set up your sources once, then continue to review your games.

entry.heading: Let's bring in your games
entry.hint: Pick where your games are. You'll set each source up next, then review everything before it's added.

yourStuff.title: Add your folders & games

clearConfirm.title: Remove all added folders & games?
clearConfirm.message: This removes every folder and game you added here. Your system's always-scanned locations aren't affected.

alwaysScanned.title: Always scanned
alwaysScanned.hint: We already scan your launchers and common locations automatically.

ignored.title: Ignored items
ignored.hint: Things you discarded while reviewing. They stay out of future scans and checks until you restore them.
ignored.empty: Nothing ignored from this source yet.
ignored.dialogHint: Games you ignored or that couldn't be identified. Scans and checks skip them until you restore them.

clearConfirm.title: Restore every ignored item?
clearConfirm.message: They'll show up again the next time this source is scanned. Nothing is added to your library.

emulators.title: Emulators
emulators.configDescription: Pick your emulators, point each one at its executable, and add the folders holding their ROMs.

retroarchCores.title: RetroArch cores
retroarchCores.description: RetroArch needs a core per system to boot a game directly. Map each platform to its core file and Play will launch straight into the ROM.

retroarch.needsExe: Set the RetroArch executable to detect its cores
retroarch.coresFolderAutoHint: Detected from the RetroArch executable and its retroarch.cfg.
retroarch.coresFolderOverridden: Using your custom folder. Auto-detect returns to the executable's own cores.
retroarch.manualHint: Map a platform to a core file by hand when detection cannot see it.
retroarch.addSystemPrompt: Add a system to organize its ROMs…
retroarch.noSystemHint: ROMs without a system import fine, but Play cannot boot them straight into RetroArch. Folders named after a system (n64, snes…) sort themselves automatically.

removeGroupConfirm.title: Remove this system group?
removeGroupConfirm.message_one: This removes {{system}} and its {{count}} ROM path from the list. Nothing is deleted from disk.
removeGroupConfirm.message_other: This removes {{system}} and its {{count}} ROM paths from the list. Nothing is deleted from disk.

retroarch.noCoreForSystem: No core is set for this system — Play will open RetroArch's menu instead of the game. Configure it from the gear above.
retroarch.coresDescription: Where the cores live, and which core boots each system. Detection fills all of this — adjust it only when you want something specific.

search.viewResults: Show what's been found so far
search.viewCandidates: Choose from the executables already found
search.viewNoResults: Nothing was found last time — open to search again
search.minimizeHint: Hide this panel — the search keeps running
search.busy: Another emulator is being searched right now.
search.title: Choose the {{name}} executable
search.empty: No matching executable was found. Search again, or use Browse to point at it directly.
search.cleared: Results cleared. Search again to look for the executable.

emulators.attribution: LastSave is not affiliated with these projects; names and logos belong to their owners.

open.hint: Launch {{name}} by itself to set it up

clearConfirm.title: Remove all emulator sources?
clearConfirm.message: Every emulator you added here — from the catalog, added manually, or imported from a front-end — will be removed from this import. What's installed on your PC isn't affected.

emulators.emptyState: No emulator sources added yet. Tap a tile above to add one.
emulators.noRoms: No ROM folders or files added yet.
emulators.dropHint: Drop ROM folders or files here

removeConfirm.title: Remove this emulator?
removeConfirm.message: {{name}} and the ROM folders you added to it will be removed from this import.

launchOptions.title: {{emulator}} launch options
launchOptions.description: How LastSave starts every game of this emulator. Everything is off by default: LastSave boots the game and leaves the rest to the emulator's own settings.
launchOptions.none: {{emulator}} has no launch options in LastSave yet. Its games boot with the minimum needed to start them.
launchOptions.useEmulatorDefaultsHint: LastSave boots the game and adds nothing — it opens exactly as it would from the emulator itself.

fullscreen.label: Fullscreen on launch
fullscreen.description: Asks the emulator to open the game fullscreen. This overrides the display setting inside the emulator.

pauseMenuExit.label: Exit from the pause menu
pauseMenuExit.description: Adds an exit item to the pause menu, so a controller on its own can quit the game.

gameLaunchOptions.title: Launch options for this game
gameLaunchOptions.description: Starts as whatever {{emulator}} is set to. Changing one here affects this game only.
gameLaunchOptions.customCommand: This game runs a custom command, so these options no longer apply to it.

continue.reasonNoSelection: Select at least one source to continue.
continue.reasonNoneReady: Finish setting up a source to continue.

scan.title: Here's what we'll bring in
scan.skippedLine: No emulator or ROMs added — set it up to include it.

lookupGate.title_other: {{count}} games couldn't be checked against the catalog

identifyGate.message: They can't be added until each one is matched to a game, added under its own name, or skipped.

emptyState.title: No games found
emptyState.hint: That usually means one of your sources needs a look.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete "{{title}}" from this list?
deleteConfirm.message: It won't be reviewed or imported, and it won't come back unless you scan again. Everything else you've decided stays as it is.

card.hasWarning: Imports fine, but something about its launch path needs a look
card.discardHint: Won't show up in future scans or checks

provenance.xboxConsole: From your Xbox history · played on console

modal.title: Review this game
modal.searchHint: Search the catalog to point this at a different game.

sources.useThisHint: Use this source for the launcher and paths. The other store’s id is kept either way.

fieldNotice.notFound: Not found — add it later if you want
fieldNotice.launcherOnly: Found through its launcher, no direct executable
fieldNotice.unresolved: Couldn't be resolved — check the path

modal.duplicateDiffGeneric: Updating fills in launch info from this scan; your history and status stay untouched.
modal.duplicateReplacesPaths: It also replaces the launch paths with the ones this scan found.

discard.title: Leave without saving?
discard.message: The status, paths, extra content and source you chose for this game have not been saved yet. Leaving now discards them.

modal.addOtherStoreHoursHint: Added to this game's hours once, at import. They don't keep syncing.

alerts.lookupFailedTitle_other: {{count}} games couldn't be checked against the catalog
alerts.lookupFailedHint: Probably a connection hiccup — they're waiting, not lost.

identify.title: Games we couldn't identify
identify.description: For each one: search for the right game and pick it, add it under its own name, or discard it. The rest of the import goes ahead either way.

ready.description: Identified — these are added with the rest.

identify.searchedFor: We searched the catalog for “{{query}}” and found no match. Try a shorter name, or leave out the edition.
identify.resolvedGoAlong: Anything you sort out here is added with the rest.

tools.title: Apps & tools

identify.searchHint: Start typing to search the catalog.

scan.wishlistNeedsReconnect: Your Epic sign-in no longer covers the store, so your wishlist was skipped. Reconnect Epic to bring it in. Everything else from Epic imported normally.
scan.xboxPlaytimeUnavailable: Xbox shared your games but not your hours this time, so they arrive without playtime. A sync later fills them in when Xbox answers.

sections.noNewGames: No new games — everything this scan found is already in your library.

exit.messageReview: You'll leave the import wizard. Your sources and setup are saved, but this review progress will be lost.

preparing.title: Getting ready to check
preparing.hint: Starting in a moment, once LastSave has finished opening.

checking.title: Looking for new games
checking.hint: This walks your folders, so it can take a minute. You can keep using LastSave.

stopped.message: Nothing had turned up yet — there may still be new games in what wasn't checked.

caughtUp.title: You're all caught up
caughtUp.message: Nothing new since your last import.

updates.hint: Games you already have. Pick what happens to each one — nothing changes your hours or moves a game unless you choose it.
